factual_claims.claim: Rental income for the full year remained flat at SEK 15,916 million compared to SEK 15,919 million in the previous year, supported by indexation and tenant improvement investments, though offset by foreign exchange effects, privatisations, and portfolio sales.

factual_claims.source_evidence: Key Figures table shows Rental income SEK m 15,916 (2025) vs 15,919 (2024). MD&A states 'Rental income, for the year, remained flat at SEK 15,916 million (15,919). The stable rental income is due to indexation and tenant improvement investments attributes while foreign exchange effects, privatisation and portfolio sales had a negative impact.'

factual_claims.claim: For the fourth quarter isolated, rental income decreased by 3.4% to SEK 3,945 million from SEK 4,083 million in the corresponding period the year before.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Q4 Highlights state 'Like-for-like rental growth of 4.6% (5.3%) and rental income of SEK 3,945 million (4,083)'. Calculation: (4,083 - 3,945)/4,083 = 3.4% decrease.

factual_claims.claim: Annualised like-for-like rental income growth reached 4.9%, driven primarily by indexation contributing 3.3%, alongside tenant improvements, occupancy enhancements, and rent reversion.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: MD&A states 'For 2025, annualised like-for-like rental income growth amounted to 4.9% (5.6%). Key drivers... indexations which contributed 3.3% of the 4.9% increase, with the remainder being tenant improvements (0.7%), occupancy improvements (0.7%), and rent reversion covering the residual (0.2%).'

factual_claims.claim: Real economic occupancy remained flat at 98.5% for the full year and increased to 98.7% for the fourth quarter.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Key Figures table shows Real economic occupancy, residential % 98.5 (2025) vs 98.5 (2024). Q4 Highlights state 'Real economic occupancy of 98.7% (98.6%)'.

factual_claims.claim: Property expenses decreased by 6.1% for the year to SEK 4,378 million from SEK 4,661 million, driven by cost control measures, digitalisation in management companies, and a shrinking portfolio size resulting from sales programmes.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Annual Review states 'Property expenses decreased by 6.1% to SEK 4,378 million (4,661). The decrease was driven by cost control measures including digitalisation in the management companies. Property expenses further decreased year over year due to the shrinking portfolio size, which is a direct result of the privatisation and portfolio sales programmes.'

factual_claims.claim: This cost discipline contributed to an improvement in net operating income to SEK 11,475 million from SEK 11,188 million, resulting in a last twelve months net operating income margin of 72.1% compared to 70.3% previously.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Key Figures table shows Net operating income SEK m 11,475 (2025) vs 11,188 (2024). Net operating income margin % 72.1 (2025) vs 70.3 (2024). MD&A states 'Net operating income improved to SEK 11,475 million (11,188), resulting in a LTM net operating income margin of 72.1% (70.3%).'

factual_claims.claim: The fair value of investment properties was SEK 324,429 million at year-end, down from SEK 335,422 million, reflecting portfolio divestments and foreign currency effects.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Key Figures table shows Fair value of investment properties SEK m 324,429 (2025) vs 335,422 (2024). MD&A states 'The total fair value of investment properties at year end was SEK 324,429 million (335,422).'

factual_claims.claim: Changes in the fair value of investment properties produced a gain of SEK 9,498 million, representing 3.0% of fair value, supported by operating fundamentals and strong residential housing markets in select regions.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: MD&A states 'Change in fair value of investment properties, for the year were SEK 9,498 million (8,553) corresponding to 3% (2.6%) of fair value.' Country breakdowns show growth in Sweden, Germany, Denmark, Czechia, Netherlands, Poland, Finland.

factual_claims.claim: Realized gains from property divestments increased to SEK 2,207 million from SEK 1,687 million, driven by the privatisation programme and portfolio sales.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Annual Review states 'Realised gains from divestment of properties increased to SEK 2,207 million (1,687) related to divestments from the privatisation programme, portfolio sales and inventory properties.'

factual_claims.claim: Cumulative privatisation sales since inception reached SEK 19,451 million across 4,443 residential units, achieving a 27.9% premium to book value.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Realised Gains/Losses section states 'Since the launch of the privatisation programme, SEK 19,451 million in total sales value has been achieved in eight countries reflecting 4,443 residential units at a 27.9% premium to book value.'

factual_claims.claim: During the fourth quarter, 798 residential units were sold for a total sales value of SEK 2,890 million at a 32.5% premium to book value.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Q4 Highlights state 'Privatisation sales of SEK 2,890 million (2,379) with 798 (530) units sold at a 32.5% (24%) premium to book value.'

factual_claims.claim: Profit before tax for the year rose significantly to SEK 16,012 million from SEK 10,403 million, while profit for the period reached SEK 13,056 million compared to SEK 7,621 million, influenced by valuation gains and foreign exchange movements.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income shows Profit before tax 16,012 (2025) vs 10,403 (2024). Profit/loss for the period 13,056 (2025) vs 7,621 (2024). MD&A states 'Profit before tax was SEK 16,012 million (10,403), driven by the factors mentioned above. Income tax expense increased to SEK 2,955 million (2,781), resulting in a profit for the year of SEK 13,056 million (7,621).' Foreign exchange gains/losses of 3,996 (2025) vs -2,038 (2024) contributed.

factual_claims.claim: On the capital and financing side, the group engaged in active liability management.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Funding section details 'As part of a series of liability management exercises in January 2025... Heimstaden issued SEK 750 million senior unsecured floating rate notes and EUR 430 million senior unsecured fixed rate notes... Heimstaden further supplemented its liability management programme in a July 2025 exercise...'

factual_claims.claim: Subsidiary Heimstaden Bostad completed approximately SEK 59,500 million in refinancings and new financings during the year across debt capital markets and bank financing.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Funding section states 'For the year, Heimstaden's subsidiary Heimstaden Bostad completed approximately SEK 59,500 million (41,900) including both refinancings and new financings, across both unsecured capital markets and a combination of secured and unsecured bank financing.'

factual_claims.claim: Interest expenses for the year were SEK 6,536 million, slightly down from SEK 6,554 million, with the average interest rate ending the year at 3.43% compared to 3.01% previously.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Funding section states 'For the year, interest expenses were SEK 6,536 million (6,554) and the average interest rate ended the year at 3.4% from 3.01% a year ago.'

factual_claims.claim: The interest coverage ratio improved to 2.0x from 1.9x.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Alternative Performance Measures table shows ICR Multiple 2.0 (Q4 2025) vs 1.9 (Q4 2024). MD&A states 'This development was driven by... refinancing of higher-cost debt... supporting an improvement in the interest coverage ratio (ICR).'

factual_claims.claim: Net loan-to-value improved significantly to 52.2% from 56.4%, driven by debt repayment funded by cash proceeds from divestments.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Alternative Performance Measures table shows Net LTV, % 52.2 (2025) vs 56.4 (2024). MD&A states 'Further deleveraging was achieved through the deployment of cash proceeds from the privatisation programme to reduce outstanding debt.'

factual_claims.claim: Total equity increased to SEK 150,557 million from SEK 147,803 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Financial Position shows Equity 150,557 (2025) vs 147,803 (2024). MD&A states 'Total equity increased to SEK 150,557 million (147,803) driven by total comprehensive income of SEK 4,199 million, offset by currency translation impacts on hybrid bonds.'

factual_claims.claim: Total assets at year-end stood at SEK 354,849 million, down from SEK 373,416 million, reflecting asset reductions from the privatisation strategy and foreign exchange translation effects.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Financial Position shows TOTAL ASSETS 354,849 (2025) vs 373,416 (2024). MD&A states 'The total fair value of investment properties at year end was SEK 324,429 million (335,422).' Foreign exchange translation differences of -8,857 contributed to the decrease.
